description_en: Creates or clones an ApsaraDB for MongoDB replica set instance
description_zh: 创建或克隆云数据库 MongoDB 版副本集实例
kebab_example: aliyun dds create-db-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --engine-version 4.4 --db-instance-class dds.mongo.standard --db-instance-storage 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDBInstance

parameters.help_en:
The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html operation to query the region ID.
When you call this operation to clone clone instance or restore clone instance from the recycle bin, set this parameter to the same value as the source instance
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID，您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html接口查询地域ID。
调用本接口克隆实例或者回收站恢复实例时，该参数值需和源实例保持一致
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The zone ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html operation to query the zone ID
parameters.help_zh: 可用区ID，您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html接口查询可用区ID
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The database engine version. Valid values:
8.0
7.0
6.0
5.0
4.4
4.2
4.0

When you call this operation to clone clone instance or restore clone instance from the recycle bin, set this parameter to the same value as the source instance.

<warning>Version 3.4 and earlier are no longer available for purchase.></warning>
parameters.help_zh:
数据库版本号，取值：
8.0
7.0
6.0
5.0
4.4
4.2
4.0

调用本接口克隆实例或者回收站恢复实例时，该参数值需和源实例保持一致。

parameters.name: engine_version

parameters.help_en: The instance type. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149719.html operation to query available instance types
parameters.help_zh: 实例规格，您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149719.html接口查询实例规格
parameters.name: db_instance_class

parameters.help_en:
The instance storage space. Unit: GB.

The valid values are subject to the instance type. For details, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/311410.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例存储空间，单位：GB。

具体取值受实例规格约束，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/311410.html
parameters.name: db_instance_storage

parameters.help_en:
The name of the instance. Valid values:

The name must start with a letter.
The name can contain digits, letters, underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-).
The name must be 2 to 256 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
实例名称，取值说明：

以中文、英文字母开头。
可以包含数字、中文、英文、下划线（_）、点（.）和短横线（-）。
长度为2~256个字符
parameters.name: db_instance_description

parameters.help_en:
The IP address whitelist of the instance. Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,). IP addresses cannot be duplicated. The following three formats are supported:

0.0.0.0/0
IP address, such as 10.23.12.24.
CIDR block, such as 10.23.12.0/24, where 24 indicates the length of the prefix in the IP address and the value ranges from 1 to 32.

You can add up to 1,000 IP addresses or CIDR blocks to all IP address whitelist groups of an instance.
If you set this parameter to 0.0.0.0/0, all IP addresses can access the instance database. Exercise caution when you use this setting
parameters.help_zh:
实例的IP白名单，多个IP地址请用英文逗号（,）分隔，不可重复。支持如下三种格式：

0.0.0.0/0
IP地址形式，例如：10.23.12.24。
CIDR形式，例如：10.23.12.0/24（无类域间路由，24表示了地址中前缀的长度，范围为1~32）。

每个实例最多添加1000个IP或IP段，即所有IP白名单分组内的IP或IP段总和不能超过1000。
0.0.0.0/0表示任何IP地址都可以访问实例的数据库，属于高危设置，请谨慎设置
parameters.name: security_ip_list

parameters.help_en:
The password of the root account. Valid values:

The password must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters.
Special characters include !@#$%^&*()_+-=
The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length.

For more information about how to database connection failures caused by special characters in the connection string, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/471568.html
parameters.help_zh:
root账号的密码，取值说明：

由大写字母、小写字母、数字和特殊字符中的至少三种组成。
!@#$%^&*()_+-=为特殊字符。
长度为8~32个字符。

关于特殊字符导致数据库连接失败的问题请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/471568.html
parameters.name: account_password

parameters.help_en:
The subscription period of the instance. Unit: months.

Valid values: 1 to 9 (integer), 12, 24, 36, and 60.

This parameter is available and required when the ChargeType parameter is set to PrePaid
parameters.help_zh:
实例的购买时长，单位为月。

取值范围：1~9（整数）、12、24、36、60。

当ChargeType参数值为PrePaid时，该参数可用且为必填参数
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:

PostPaid: default value. Pay-as-you-go.
PrePaid: subscription.

If you set this parameter to PrePaid, you must also specify the Period parameter
parameters.help_zh:
实例的付费类型，取值说明：

PostPaid：默认值，后付费（按量付费）。
PrePaid：预付费（包年包月）。

当该参数的值为PrePaid时，您还需要配置Period参数
parameters.name: charge_type

parameters.help_en:
The network type of the instance. Valid values:

VPC: VPC
parameters.help_zh:
实例的网络类型，取值说明：

VPC：专有网络
parameters.name: network_type

parameters.help_en: The VPC ID
parameters.help_zh: 专有网络（VPC）ID
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The vSwitch ID
parameters.help_zh: 虚拟交换机ID
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the source instance.
When you call this operation to clone an instance, you must specify this parameter and either the BackupId or RestoreTime parameter. When you call this operation to revoke an instance from the recycle bin, you need to specify only this parameter. You do not need to specify the BackupId or RestoreTime parameter
parameters.help_zh:
源实例ID。
调用本接口克隆实例时，您需要配置该参数，同时还需要配置BackupId或RestoreTime参数。调用本接口进行回收站恢复时，只需要传入该参数，无需配置BackupId或RestoreTime
parameters.name: src_db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The backup ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62172.html operation to query the backup ID.
This parameter is required only when you call this operation to clone an instance from a backup. You must also specify the SrcDBInstanceId parameter
parameters.help_zh:
备份点ID，您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62172.html接口查询备份点ID。
只有调用本接口按备份点克隆实例时，您需要配置该参数，同时还需要配置SrcDBInstanceId参数
parameters.name: backup_id

parameters.help_en: The point in time to which you want to restore the instance. You can specify any point in time within the past seven days. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC). This parameter is required only when you call this operation to clone an instance to a point in time. You must also specify the SrcDBInstanceId parameter
parameters.help_zh: 选择要恢复的时间点，您可以配置7天内的任意时间点。格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 只有调用本接口按时间点克隆实例时，您需要配置该参数，同时还需要配置SrcDBInstanceId参数
parameters.name: restore_time

parameters.help_en: The additional parameter. Business information
parameters.help_zh: 附加参数，业务信息
parameters.name: business_info

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal for the instance. Valid values:

true: Auto-renewal is enabled.
false: default value. Auto-renewal is disabled. You must manually renew the instance.

This parameter is available and optional when the ChargeType parameter is set to PrePaid
parameters.help_zh:
实例是否自动续费，取值说明：

true：自动续费。
false：默认值，不自动续费，即手动续费。

当ChargeType参数值为PrePaid时，该参数可用且为可选参数
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
The name of the database.
When you call this operation to clone an instance, you can specify this parameter to clone specific databases. If you do not specify this parameter, all databases of the instance are cloned
parameters.help_zh:
数据库名。
调用本接口克隆实例时，您可以通过配置该参数指定需要克隆的数据库，如果不配置该参数，则克隆实例的所有数据库
parameters.name: database_names

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use coupons. Valid values:
default or null (default): Coupons are used.
youhuiquan_promotion_option_id_for_blank: Coupons are not used
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用优惠券，取值说明：
default或null（默认）：使用优惠券。

parameters.help_en:
The storage engine of the instance. Set the value to WiredTiger.
When you call this operation to clone clone instance or restore clone instance from the recycle bin, set this parameter to the same value as the source instance.
For more information about the constraints on storage engines and versions, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61906.html
parameters.help_zh:

调用本接口克隆实例或回收站恢复实例时，该参数需和源实例保持一致。
关于存储引擎与版本的选择约束，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61906.html

parameters.help_en:
The number of primary and secondary nodes in the replica set instance. Valid values:

3 (default)
5
7

<notice>You do not need to specify this parameter for standalone instances.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
副本集实例的主备节点数，取值：

3（默认值）
5
7

<notice>单节点实例可不传该参数></notice>
parameters.name: replication_factor

parameters.help_en: The number of read-only nodes in the replica set instance. Valid values: 0 to 5 (integer). Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 副本集实例的只读节点数，取值范围：0~5（整数），默认值为0

parameters.help_zh: 数据库引擎，固定取值：MongoDB

parameters.help_en:
The storage type. Valid values:
cloud_essd1: PL1 ESSD.
cloud_essd2: PL2 ESSD.
cloud_essd3: PL3 ESSD.
cloud_auto: ESSD AutoPL.
local_ssd: local SSD.

When you purchase a standalone instance with cloud_essd1, the actual cloud disk type used is cloud_essd.
ESSD AutoPL is supported only on the China site (aliyun.com).
Instances that run version 4.4 or later use cloud_essd1 by default.
Instances that run version 4.2 or earlier use local_ssd by default
parameters.help_zh:
存储类型，取值说明：
cloud_essd1：ESSD PL1云盘。
cloud_essd2：ESSD PL2云盘。
cloud_essd3：ESSD PL3云盘。
cloud_auto：ESSD AutoPL云盘。
local_ssd：SSD本地盘。

单节点实例购买传递 cloud_essd1，实际使用 cloud_essd 云盘。
ESSD AutoPL云盘目前仅支持中国站。
4.4及以上版本实例默认为cloud_essd1。
4.2及以下版本实例默认为local_ssd
parameters.name: storage_type
